PPP MEDSAMPLE03
Occupational English Test

WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
SAMPLE RESPONSE: LETTER OF REFERRAL




Ms Alison Goody
Occupational therapist
Northwood Community Health Centre
Northwood



10 June 2018



Dear Ms Goody

Re. Ms Betty Weston, DOB: 12.2.64

I am referring Ms Betty Weston to you for management of her carpal tunnel syndrome.
Ms Weston presented to the Outpatients Clinic at Northwood Hospital with pain in her right hand, and numbness and
tingling in her thumb, index and middle finger. She has not suffered any injury to the hand and reports no pain in other
joints. She also complains of pain waking her at night but is able to relieve it by moving her fingers. She sometimes
drops things and is unable to grip a glass or cup. Phalen’s manoeuvre and Tinel’s sign were positive.

The patient’s general health is not optimal as she suffers from Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, hypothyroidism and arthrosis
and is overweight. Her job as a supermarket manager is very tiring physically, and the problem is compounded by the
fact that at home she looks after her elderly mother.

I would be grateful if you could see Ms Weston for an ergonomics assessment and apply a wrist splint (custom-made,
neutral position), to be worn at night for 3 months.

Ms Weston will also be referred to a physical therapist for aerobic fitness and a weight-loss programme.

If you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me,

Yours sincerely,




Doctor
